'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2023 Syria clashes]]
***A United States [[Private military contractor|contractor]] is killed and five others are injured when a [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] hits a U.S. base near [[Al-Hasakah]] in northern [[Syria]]. **A [[police raid]] in a [[favela]] in [[São Gonçalo, Rio de Janeiro|São Gonçalo]], [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], results in the deaths of 13 people and the capture of two [[Comando Vermelho]] gang leaders from the northern [[states of Brazil|states]] of [[Pará]] and [[Sergipe]]. ***Former [[Indian National Congress]] president [[Rahul Gandhi]] is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to two years in prison for [[defamation|defaming]] Prime Minister [[Narendra Modi]] during a campaign rally in April 2019. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-65048602 (BBC News)]
